title: limnia heterophylla
intro: Limnia heterophylla, commonly known as Sweet Annie, is a perennial herb in the mint family native to Asia. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Limnia heterophylla include its ability to relieve coughs, reduce fever, and ease digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
